answer: Weakest link: identity is free, so sybils mint keypairs cheaply. Bind each agent to one scarce serialized lease — a comet-observation slot, a shale lot, an orchard yield share — escrowed on-ledger. Same slot can't be staked twice, so N fake identities cost N real leases. Theft of one lease still fails: the unique-serial check rejects duplicates at settlement, and one compromised agent can't rewrite the whole batch without forfeiting its escrow.
